title: AI4Plasma I: Data-Efficient Surrogate Modeling of Capacitively Coupled Plasma Fields
abstract: arXiv:2611.15002v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reference capacitively coupled plasma (CCP) simulations provide spatially resolved plasma fields but are costly to generate across operating conditions. We compare the data efficiency of five surrogate architectures--Coordinate MLP, PCA-Net, U-Net, Fourier neural operator (FNO), and Transolver--for predicting RF-cycle-averaged electron density, ion density, electric potential, and electron temperature in 1D planar and 2D axisymmetric GEC CCP benchmarks. We assess the number of reference simulations needed to achieve 1% and 2% mean relative L2 error for parameter-interior and parameter-boundary test cases, and examine architecture-specific mechanisms. FNO achieves the lowest or joint-lowest reference-case requirement in seven of eight comparisons. In 1D, FNO reaches 1% interior error with 50 training cases, compared with 100 for Transolver and 200 for U-Net. In 2D, FNO and U-Net each reach 1% interior error with 100 cases; FNO and Tra

translated_title: AI4Plasma I：电容耦合等离子体场的数据高效代理建模
translated_abstract: 参考电容耦合等离子体（CCP）模拟能够提供空间分辨的等离子体场，但在不同工作条件下生成这些数据的成本十分高昂。我们比较了五种代理模型架构——坐标MLP（Coordinate MLP）、PCA-Net、U-Net、傅里叶神经算子（FNO）和Transolver——在预测一维平面和二维轴对称GEC CCP基准测试中射频周期平均电子密度、离子密度、电势和电子温度方面的数据效率。我们评估了在参数内部和参数边界测试用例中达到1%和2%平均相对L2误差所需的参考模拟数量，并考察了各架构特有的作用机制。在八项比较中的七项里，FNO实现了最低或并列最低的参考案例需求。在一维情形下，FNO仅需50个训练案例即可达到1%的内部误差，而Transolver需要100个，U-Net需要200个。在二维情形下，FNO和U-Net均用100个案例达到1%的内部误差；FNO和Tra（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究系统比较了五种神经代理架构在电容耦合等离子体场预测中的数据效率，发现傅里叶神经算子（FNO）在绝大多数测试场景中以最少的训练模拟数量即可达到1%误差精度，是数据效率最优的架构选择。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks the data efficiency of five neural surrogate architectures for predicting capacitively coupled plasma fields, demonstrating that the Fourier neural operator (FNO) achieves 1% error accuracy with the fewest reference simulations in most test scenarios.
